claims: As of March 20, 2026, average 30-year fixed mortgage rates have moved back above 6.5%.
As of March 20, 2026, average 30-year fixed mortgage rates rose from previous weekly lows in the 6.1%–6.2% range.
As of March 20, 2026, the average 30-year fixed rate is between 6.32% and 6.53%, notes WSJ and Mortgage News Daily.
As of March 20, 2026, rates for 15-year fixed-rate mortgages average around 5.54% to 6.07%, according to Freddie Mac and Mortgage News Daily.
As of March 20, 2026, 7/6 SOFR ARM rates average around 6.19%, according to Mortgage News Daily.
According to Wolf Street, 10-year Treasury yields have spiked.
The Federal Reserve has maintained a steady stance on federal funds rates as of March 18, 2026, say the WSJ and Yahoo Finance.
Higher rates in late March have reduced refinance activity, reports the WSJ.
